run: vitest single fork, DB env unset, 2026-10-04

tests.test: N1 halt — an empty declared read table halts with an errored FAIL gate row
N2 warn — the same empty table yields a WARN gate row that does not halt
N3 run — the same empty table yields an INFO row and no halt
N4 clean — every counted table non-zero yields one INFO row carrying the counts
N5 self-written table excluded — the step never counts the table it writes
N6 expect_nonempty false — no query and no row even when a read table is empty
N7 runner wiring — measureInputGuards runs pre-dispatch and gates compute
